title: Melon Ice Cream Visual Makeover
body:
Description:
🍉→🍦 Purely Visual Melon Transformation →🍦
This resource pack does not add any new features to the game—it only changes the appearance of melons!

· 🍉 Regular melons now look like green ice cream
· 🥭 Glistering melons now resemble golden ice cream
· ✅ No gameplay changes – purely graphical
· 🔧 No new items – purely a texture replacement

Compatible with modern Minecraft versions using the same resource pack format as 1.20.6 and 1.21.4, including:

· ✅ 1.20.6
· ✅ 1.21.0
· ✅ 1.21.1
· ✅ 1.21.2
· ✅ 1.21.3
· ✅ 1.21.4

(For older versions below 1.20.6, check the legacy edition!)
## **Create or customize free mod packs and resource packs: modpacks.max@gmail.com**
